verdict.rationale: Slack documents a first-party App Directory with over 2,600 prebuilt apps, such as Salesforce, Jira and Google Drive, plus a help article on adding apps to a workspace. Integrations connect 'in just a few clicks,' so the core story is delivered. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the admin install and approval flow (only implied by help-article keywords like 'approving apps' and 'administrators'), independent or hands-on corroboration of installing from the directory.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can install prebuilt integrations from an app directory or marketplace

citations.quote: Choose from over 2,600 apps in the Slack App Directory — from Salesforce, Jira, Google Drive, ChatGPT, and more.
